question: What were Analog Devices' total assets as of October 28, 2023 (the end of its fiscal 2023), in USD millions?
What were Marvell's total assets at the end of fiscal 2023 (January 28, 2023)?
How much net cash was provided by operating activities at ON Semiconductor in fiscal 2022 (year ended December 31, 2022)?
What was Microchip's research and development expense for fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024)?
What was NVIDIA's research and development expense in fiscal 2023 (ended January 29, 2023)?
What were AMD's total assets as of December 28, 2024 (the end of fiscal 2024)?
How much did Texas Instruments spend on capital expenditures in 2023, according to its cash flow statement? Report the amount as a positive number.

For Analog Devices in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024), what was free cash flow, defined as net cash provided by operating activities minus additions to property, plant and equipment, net (from the cash flow statement), in USD millions, and what was free cash flow as a percentage of revenue (from the income statement)?

For Marvell in fiscal 2024 (ended February 3, 2024), what was free cash flow, defined as net cash provided by operating activities minus purchases of property and equipment, and what was free cash flow as a percentage of net revenue?

What was ON Semiconductor's return on assets for fiscal 2023, defined as net income attributable to ON Semiconductor Corporation for the year ended December 31, 2023 divided by total assets at December 31, 2023, expressed as a percentage?
For Microchip in fiscal 2023 (ended March 31, 2023), what were capital expenditures (from the cash flow statement, treated as a positive amount) as a percentage of net sales?
What was Micron's asset turnover for fiscal 2024, defined as revenue for the year ended August 29, 2024 divided by total assets as of August 29, 2024, expressed as a ratio?
For Texas Instruments in 2024, what was free cash flow, defined as cash flows from operating activities minus capital expenditures, and what was free cash flow as a percentage of revenue?

What was Qualcomm's return on equity for fiscal 2023, defined as net income for the year ended September 24, 2023 divided by total stockholders' equity at September 24, 2023, expressed as a percentage?
Using the income statement in Analog Devices' fiscal 2022 10-K, by what percentage did revenue grow from fiscal 2021 (ended October 30, 2021) to fiscal 2022 (ended October 29, 2022)?
By what percentage did Marvell's net revenue grow from fiscal 2022 (ended January 29, 2022) to fiscal 2023 (ended January 28, 2023)?
By what percentage did ON Semiconductor's revenue change from 2023 to 2024? Report the change as a signed percentage (negative for a decline).
Using the income statement in Microchip's fiscal 2022 10-K, by what percentage did net sales grow from fiscal 2021 (ended March 31, 2021) to fiscal 2022 (ended March 31, 2022)?
By what percentage did AMD's research and development expense grow from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024?
By what percentage did Micron's revenue grow from fiscal 2023 (ended August 31, 2023) to fiscal 2024 (ended August 29, 2024)?

By what percentage did Broadcom's net income change from fiscal 2023 (ended October 29, 2023) to fiscal 2024 (ended November 3, 2024)? Report the change as a signed percentage (negative for a decline).
What was Marvell's net loss for fiscal 2023 (ended January 28, 2023), and what was it as a percentage of net revenue? Report the net loss and the percentage as negative numbers.

For Analog Devices in fiscal 2022 (ended October 29, 2022), what was net cash used for financing activities, and what was the sum of net cash provided by operating activities, net cash used for investing activities and net cash used for financing activities (before the effect of exchange rate changes)? Report cash used as negative numbers, in USD millions.

For ON Semiconductor in 2024, what was net cash used in investing activities, and what was the net cash flow from short-term investments, defined as proceeds from maturity of short-term investments and available-for-sale securities minus purchases of short-term investments and available-for-sale securities? Report outflows as negative numbers.

For Microchip in fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024), what were net cash used in investing activities and net cash used in financing activities, and what was their combined total? Report cash used as negative numbers.

For Intel in fiscal 2023, what was free cash flow, defined as net cash provided by operating activities minus additions to property, plant, and equipment (as reported in Intel's 2023 10-K cash flow statement)? Report the result as a signed number (negative if additions exceed operating cash flow).

For Micron in fiscal 2023 (ended August 31, 2023), what was free cash flow, defined as net cash provided by operating activities minus expenditures for property, plant, and equipment, and what was free cash flow as a percentage of revenue? Report both as signed numbers (negative if expenditures exceed operating cash flow).

For Qualcomm in fiscal 2022 (ended September 25, 2022), what were net cash used by investing activities and net cash used by financing activities, and what was the sum of net cash provided by operating activities, net cash used by investing activities and net cash used by financing activities (excluding the effect of exchange rate changes)? Report cash used as negative numbers.

In ON Semiconductor's (onsemi) 10-K for fiscal 2024 (year ended December 31, 2024), what was the Power Solutions Group (PSG) segment's gross margin in 2024 (segment gross profit divided by segment revenue), and what share of onsemi's total 2024 revenue did PSG represent? Report both as percentages to two decimals.

For Microchip's fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024), what was the gross margin of its semiconductor products segment (segment gross profit divided by segment net sales), and what percentage of Microchip's total net sales came from its technology licensing segment? Report both as percentages to two decimals.

What was Marvell's net revenue from the data center end market in fiscal 2024 (ended February 3, 2024), in USD millions, and what percentage of Marvell's total fiscal 2024 net revenue did it represent (to two decimals)?

What was Analog Devices' revenue from the Industrial end market in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024), in USD millions, and what percentage of total fiscal 2024 revenue did the Industrial end market represent (to two decimals, computed from the reported dollar amounts)?

For Qualcomm's fiscal 2024 (ended September 29, 2024), what was the QTL (licensing) segment's EBT margin (QTL earnings before income taxes divided by QTL licensing revenues), and what percentage of Qualcomm's total revenues did QTL segment revenues represent? Report both as percentages to two decimals.

For Micron's fiscal 2024 (ended August 29, 2024), what was the Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU) operating margin (CNBU operating income divided by CNBU revenue), and what share of Micron's total revenue did CNBU represent? Report both as percentages to two decimals.

For Texas Instruments in 2023, what was the Embedded Processing segment's operating profit as a percentage of its revenue, and what percentage of TI's total 2023 revenue came from Embedded Processing? Report both as percentages to two decimals.

Compare operating margin (operating income divided by revenue/net sales) for Analog Devices in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024) and Microchip in fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024). What was each company's operating margin, and how many percentage points higher was Microchip's (Microchip minus Analog Devices)?

Compare research and development intensity (R&D expense divided by revenue) for Marvell in fiscal 2023 (ended January 28, 2023) and ON Semiconductor in fiscal 2023 (ended December 31, 2023). What was each company's R&D intensity as a percentage, and what is the difference in percentage points (Marvell minus ON Semiconductor)?

Compare the current ratio (total current assets divided by total current liabilities) of ON Semiconductor at December 31, 2023 (end of its fiscal 2023) and Microchip at March 31, 2023 (end of its fiscal 2023). What was each company's current ratio (to two decimals), and what is the difference (ON Semiconductor minus Microchip), computed from the unrounded ratios and then rounded to two decimals?

What share of total revenue came from the automotive end market for ON Semiconductor in fiscal 2024 (year ended December 31, 2024) and for Analog Devices in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024), computed from each company's reported automotive end-market revenue and total revenue? Give each share as a percentage and the difference in percentage points (ON Semiconductor minus Analog Devices).

Compare selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expense as a percentage of total revenue for Qualcomm in fiscal 2023 (ended September 24, 2023) and Broadcom in fiscal 2023 (ended October 29, 2023). What was each ratio, and how many percentage points higher was Qualcomm's (Qualcomm minus Broadcom)?

Compare the free cash flow margin in fiscal 2024 of AMD (year ended December 28, 2024) and Texas Instruments (year ended December 31, 2024), where free cash flow is net cash provided by operating activities minus purchases of property and equipment (AMD) or capital expenditures (TI), taken from each cash flow statement, and free cash flow margin is free cash flow divided by revenue. What was each company's free cash flow margin, and what is the difference in percentage points (Texas Instruments minus AMD)?

Compare gross margin percentage (gross margin divided by revenue) for Intel in fiscal 2022 (year ended December 31, 2022) and Micron in fiscal 2022 (ended September 1, 2022). What was each company's gross margin percentage, and how many percentage points higher was Micron's (Micron minus Intel)?

Using Analog Devices' fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024) income statement, compute its gross margin percentage (gross margin divided by revenue), and state what Analog Devices said primarily caused its gross margin percentage to decline versus fiscal 2023.

Using Marvell's fiscal 2024 (ended February 3, 2024) consolidated statement of operations, compute its gross margin percentage (gross profit divided by net revenue), and state what Marvell said drove the increase in cost of goods sold as a percentage of net revenue versus fiscal 2023.

Using Microchip's income statement, compute the percentage change in net sales from fiscal 2023 (ended March 31, 2023) to fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024), reported as a signed percentage, and state what Microchip said was the primary reason for the change.
Using ON Semiconductor's (onsemi) fiscal 2022 10-K income statement, compute the percentage change in revenue from 2021 to 2022, and state what onsemi said the revenue increase was attributable to.

Using AMD's fiscal 2023 (year ended December 30, 2023) income statement, compute its operating margin (operating income divided by net revenue), and state what AMD said primarily caused operating income to decrease from 2022.

Using NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 (ended January 28, 2024) income statement, compute its gross margin percentage from revenue and cost of revenue, and state what NVIDIA said drove the increase in gross margin versus fiscal 2023.

Using Broadcom's fiscal 2023 (ended October 29, 2023) income statement, compute gross margin as a percentage of total net revenue, and state what Broadcom said was the primary reason gross margin increased versus fiscal 2022.

Which of Marvell's five end markets had the highest percentage net revenue growth in fiscal 2023 (ended January 28, 2023) compared with fiscal 2022 (ended January 29, 2022)? Give that end market's fiscal 2023 net revenue in USD millions and its growth rate as a percentage to two decimals, computed from the reported revenue figures.

Which of Microchip's three product lines (mixed-signal microcontrollers, analog, other) had the highest percentage net sales growth in fiscal 2023 (ended March 31, 2023) versus fiscal 2022? Give its growth rate as a percentage to two decimals, computed from the reported net sales, and state what Microchip said drove that product line's increase.

According to Analog Devices' 10-K for fiscal 2023 (ended October 28, 2023), which end market had the highest percentage revenue growth in fiscal 2023 versus fiscal 2022? Give its growth rate as a percentage to two decimals, computed from the reported revenue amounts, and state which applications Analog Devices said drove demand in that end market.

In ON Semiconductor's (onsemi) 10-K for fiscal 2024 (year ended December 31, 2024), which of its three reportable segments (PSG, AMG, ISG) had the highest segment gross margin (segment gross profit divided by segment revenue) in 2024? Give that margin as a percentage to two decimals and state what onsemi said primarily caused that segment's gross margin to change from 2023.

Which of Qualcomm's three QCT revenue streams (handsets, automotive, IoT) grew fastest in percentage terms in fiscal 2024 (ended September 29, 2024) versus fiscal 2023? Give that revenue stream's fiscal 2024 revenue in USD millions, its growth rate as a percentage to two decimals, and what Qualcomm said drove the increase.

In NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 (ended January 29, 2023), which of its two reportable segments (Compute & Networking or Graphics) had the higher operating margin (segment operating income divided by segment revenue), and what was that margin as a percentage to two decimals?

Among the operating segments Intel reported for 2023 (year ended December 30, 2023) — Client Computing Group, Data Center and AI, Network and Edge, Mobileye and Intel Foundry Services, excluding 'all other' — which had the highest operating margin (segment operating income divided by segment net revenue)? Give that segment's 2023 operating income in USD millions and its operating margin as a percentage to two decimals.
Which two acquisitions did Marvell complete during fiscal 2022 (ended January 29, 2022), on what date did each close, and what form of consideration was used in each?

According to ON Semiconductor's (onsemi's) 2022 10-K, which fabrication facility did the company acquire on December 31, 2022, from which company, and what was the total consideration in USD millions?

According to Microchip's fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024) 10-K, what did Microchip do in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024 with the capacity expansion plans at its Fab 4 and Fab 5 facilities, and what were the stated dollar sizes of those two investment plans (in USD millions)?

According to Analog Devices' fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024) 10-K, what was the primary reason revenue decreased compared with fiscal 2023, and in which two end markets was the decline most pronounced?

According to NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 (ended January 29, 2023) 10-K, when was the termination of NVIDIA's agreement to acquire Arm from SoftBank announced, why was the deal terminated, and what did the acquisition termination cost recorded in fiscal 2023 reflect?

According to Intel's 2022 10-K, on what date did Intel complete the IPO of Mobileye, on which exchange and under what ticker symbol did Mobileye's class A shares begin trading, and approximately what percentage of Mobileye's capital stock did Intel retain after the IPO?

According to AMD's fiscal 2024 10-K, which company did AMD agree in August 2024 to acquire to strengthen its data center AI infrastructure capabilities, when was that acquisition expected to close, and what did AMD intend to do with the acquired company's manufacturing business?

What percentage of revenue came from sales to distributors at Analog Devices in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024) and at ON Semiconductor in 2024, and which of the two companies relied more heavily on distributors?
How many reportable segments did Marvell (fiscal 2024, ended February 3, 2024) and Microchip (fiscal 2024, ended March 31, 2024) each report, and what were those segments?
What share of revenue came from each company's ten largest customers at Marvell in fiscal 2024 (ended February 3, 2024) and at Micron in fiscal 2024 (ended August 29, 2024)?

How did Analog Devices (fiscal 2024, ended November 2, 2024) and Microchip (fiscal 2024, ended March 31, 2024) each quantify their reliance on third-party wafer foundries, and which foundry does Analog Devices name?

Using Micron's fiscal 2022 (ended September 1, 2022) 10-K and Texas Instruments' 2022 10-K: why did Micron sell its Lehi, Utah fab, on what date did the sale to Texas Instruments close, and when did Texas Instruments begin production at the Lehi facility?

What stock splits did NVIDIA (as described in its fiscal 2022 10-K, fiscal year ended January 30, 2022) and Broadcom (as described in its fiscal 2024 10-K, fiscal year ended November 3, 2024) carry out, and on what dates?

AMD and Intel each described a 2024 Restructuring Plan in their fiscal 2024 10-Ks. What was each plan's stated aim, and approximately what percentage workforce reduction did each company expect from it?
What was ON Semiconductor's total revenue for fiscal year 2025?
How much net revenue did Marvell earn from Amazon Web Services in fiscal 2024 (ended February 3, 2024)?
According to Microchip's fiscal 2024 (ended March 31, 2024) 10-K, how many 8-inch wafers per month can its Fab 4 in Gresham, Oregon produce?
How much revenue did Analog Devices generate from sales to Apple in fiscal 2024 (ended November 2, 2024)?
What was Samsung Electronics' memory semiconductor revenue in calendar 2023?
What was Micron's revenue from HBM (high-bandwidth memory) products in fiscal 2024 (ended August 29, 2024)?
What was Qualcomm's QCT segment revenue in fiscal 2019 (ended September 29, 2019)?
